sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is facing trial in the said case since the year 2012 and charges were also framed in the year 2012 but no substantial progress has been made in the trial so far.

Earlier by order dated 02.08.2022 passed in Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.10543 of 2022, the trial Court was directed to expedite the trial and to make every endeavour to decide the case expeditiously preferably within a period of one year without grating any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties but despite that no substantial progress has been made so far. Learned counsel further submitted that a direction may be issued to the concerned court to decide the aforesaid case within specific time frame.

4. In view of aforesaid, the trial Court concerned is directed to expedite the trial and to make every endeavour to decide the aforesaid case as early as possible, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of copy of this order before the court concerned, provided there is no legal impediment.
5. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
6. A copy of this order be transmitted to the trial court concerned for necessary compliance.

Order Date :- 12.8.2024 SP/-
